displayName: Fashion Nova API - Sale Prices, Sizes in Stock, Reviews
description: Fashion Nova API for Fashion Nova sale prices - each style's price, the compare-at (struck-through) price and the percent off computed from the two, the final-sale flag and per-size stock, in any of Fashion Nova's 104 countries in the local currency (37 currencies; English everywhere, Spanish in 67 countries). Keyword search (60 per page, up to page 18), any collection up to about 10,000 products (sale, best sellers, new, back in stock, Black Friday deals), one style in full with every colour and size, reviews (10 per page, up to page 8, one pool per style, mostly English), the category tree, search suggestions and similar styles. 7 endpoints, 1 credit per call. In the 27 EEA countries there is no compare-at price, so no percent off. No stores, brand directory or price history (poll and store).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
